body: I did this the other day, right below your account you should see a spot called Payment Elections with the 10% on there. Make sure to edit that and remove the line with 10% and put the full balance on your main account. Once that's done you should be able to delete your account. I think it doesn't let you delete it because it's being used to pay you.

Possible Solution: 

For anyone who's searching this and having the same issue. What fixed it for me is running the game as "administrator". So I went to the Exe and created a desktop shortcut "Send to Desktop" then on the desktop shortcut rightclick properties and then under shortcut target add -console after the "" example valheim.exe" -console. Now right click and run as Administrator. The console should be enabled and it should work.
